text_blocks.snippet: The best gift for a Griha Pravesh (housewarming ceremony) is an auspicious item that brings good luck, positivity, and warmth to the new home, such as a brass Lakshmi-Ganesh idol set or a decorative brass urli.
snippet_highlighted_words: a brass Lakshmi-Ganesh idol set or a decorative brass urli

list.snippet: Idols & Divine Sculptures: A brass or silver-plated Lakshmi-Ganesh pair, Kamdhenu cow with calf, or a Vastu tortoise symbolize wealth, prosperity, and protection.
Pooja Essentials: A finely crafted brass or silver Puja Thali Set or a set of heavy brass diyas for daily rituals.
Traditional Decor: A brass urli (filled with water and fresh flower petals) or an auspicious wall hanging like a golden toran.
Ambient Lighting: An artisan-crafted table lamp or elegant candle holders to bring warmth to the new spaces.
Greenery: An indoor air-purifying plant like an Areca Palm in a sleek ceramic planter.
Serveware & Dining: Premium dinner sets, crystal glassware, or stylish brass storage boxes for the new kitchen.
Home Fragrances: Luxury diffuser sets or scented candles to make the new house smell welcoming.
